objects.description: Opaque handle base type used throughout libharu when built in shared/DLL mode. It is a void* used as the underlying representation for many API object types (document, page, image, font, annotations, etc.). All listed aliases are distinct opaque types that typedef to HPDF_HANDLE. Construction and destruction are performed exclusively via the API functions; the actual structures are not defined in this header.

Opaque handle to a PDF annotation object. This header declares factory functions that create various kinds of annotations and a validator, but the actual struct/typedef definition is not present here. Treat as an opaque type defined elsewhere in libharu.

objects.definition: typedef HPDF_Dict HPDF_Catalog;
objects.description: Alias type for the PDF Catalog object. In Haru, the catalog is represented as a dictionary (HPDF_Dict) at the root of the document that holds references to document-wide structures (pages tree, names, viewer preferences, etc.). Since this header only typedefs the name, HPDF_Catalog has the same underlying representation and lifetime semantics as HPDF_Dict. Specific fields and structure are not defined here.

objects.definition: #define HPDF_FILEP                  FILE*
objects.description: Preprocessor macro aliasing the C standard library FILE* type. This header does not define a new type; it simply maps HPDF_FILEP to FILE*. As a macro, not a typedef, it cannot be used to declare distinct pointers beyond FILE*.

Opaque handle type representing a PDF destination (a jump target within a PDF). The actual struct/typedef is not defined in this header; it is likely defined in hpdf_objects.h. This header only declares functions that operate on HPDF_Destination.
Opaque handle for Haru PDF memory manager. Not defined in this header; only referenced as a parameter to construct destinations.
Opaque handle for a PDF page object. Not defined in this header; only referenced as a parameter to construct destinations.
Opaque handle for the cross-reference table manager. Not defined in this header; only referenced as a parameter to construct destinations.

Boolean typedef used by libharu APIs. Not defined in this header; only used as a return type for validation. As a typedef to an integral type, its pointer form would be HPDF_BOOL *, but the base type definition is absent here.

Core document object of libHaru. HPDF_Doc_Rec aggregates the document-wide state: memory manager, catalog, outlines, xref table, pages hierarchy and current page, lists for pages, fonts, encoders, error record, info/trailer dictionaries, compression and encryption settings, default and current encoder, PDF/A settings, and output stream. HPDF_Doc is a pointer typedef to this struct used throughout the API. Construction and destruction are managed by the library’s higher-level API (not defined in this header).
Enumeration of high-level encoder kinds the library supports, including Standard, MacRoman, WinAnsi, and font-specific encodings.
State record used while parsing encoded text: holds the buffer pointer, current index, total length, and the current byte classification.

objects.definition: typedef struct _HPDF_Encoder_Rec *HPDF_Encoder;
objects.description: Opaque handle to an encoder instance. Points to an HPDF_Encoder_Rec describing behavior and function pointers for encoding operations.
Function pointer type returning the byte type for the current parse state for a given encoder.
Function pointer type converting a code point in the encoder’s code space to a Unicode value.
Function pointer type that encodes an input text buffer with a given encoder, returning an allocated/temporary encoded buffer and its length.
Function pointer type that writes encoder data (e.g., to a PDF stream).

objects.definition:

objects.definition:

Concrete encoder vtable/object record. Contains identity fields, error/memory managers, encoder type, function pointers implementing behavior, and an attribute pointer to encoder-specific data.
Enumeration of base encodings used by basic encoders and font resources.

objects.definition: typedef struct _HPDF_BasicEncoderAttr_Rec  *HPDF_BasicEncoderAttr;
objects.description: Opaque pointer to the attribute block used by a basic (single-byte) encoder.
Concrete attribute record for basic encoders: tracks the base encoding name, supported character range, Unicode mapping table, and differences array for PDF encoding differences.
Function pointer type that tests whether a byte is a lead/trailing byte under a CMap encoder.
Record describing a CID range mapping: code points from 'from' to 'to' map to sequential CIDs starting at 'cid'.
Record mapping a single code value to a Unicode value for CMap encoders.

objects.definition: typedef struct _HPDF_CMapEncoderAttr_Rec  *HPDF_CMapEncoderAttr;
objects.description: Opaque pointer to attribute data for a CMap (CID) encoder.
Concrete attribute record for CMap (CID) encoders: includes Unicode and CID maps, ranges, writing mode, registry/ordering/supplement identifiers, byte classification callbacks, and XUID/UID info.

MD5 context object used by the internal MD5 implementation. Holds intermediate state (buffer, bit counters, input block). Used with HPDF_MD5Init/HPDF_MD5Update/HPDF_MD5Final to compute 16-byte MD5 digests.
ARC4 stream cipher context. Maintains index bytes and 256-byte state (S-box) used for keystream generation during encryption/decryption.

objects.definition: typedef struct _HPDF_Encrypt_Rec  *HPDF_Encrypt;
objects.description: Opaque handle (pointer) to an encryption record object controlling PDF encryption parameters and state. The underlying struct is defined below as HPDF_Encrypt_Rec.

Concrete encryption record storing parameters and derived keys for PDF encryption. Includes encryption mode (HPDF_EncryptMode, defined elsewhere), key length, plaintext and encrypted owner/user passwords, permissions flags, file ID, working/MD5 keys, and an ARC4 context for stream operations.

Opaque handle to a PDF encryption dictionary object used by libharu. This header only declares the type by usage in function prototypes; the actual struct/typedef definition is not present here, implying it is defined elsewhere (likely in hpdf_objects.h). Acts as the primary object for configuring/holding encryption settings and IDs for a document.
Opaque handle representing the underlying encryption state/engine associated with an HPDF_EncryptDict. Only referenced as a return type; its concrete definition is not present in this header.
Opaque handle to a generic PDF dictionary object in libharu. In this header it is only referenced for passing document info dictionaries and for a free callback. No definition is provided here.
Opaque handle to the memory manager used by libharu. Referenced as a parameter for constructing HPDF_EncryptDict; definition not included here.
Opaque handle to the cross-reference table of a PDF document. Used during creation and preparation of the encryption dictionary. Not defined in this header.
Status code type used by libharu APIs to signal success or specific error codes. Only used as a return type here; definition not included in this header.
Boolean type used by libharu APIs. Only used as a return type here; definition not included in this header.

Error object used by libharu to capture and report error codes and details. It holds the last error code (error_no), an optional detail code (detail_no), a callback handler (error_fn), and a user_data pointer for caller context. HPDF_Error is a typedef to a pointer to the struct, making it an opaque handle in APIs. Construction/initialization is performed by HPDF_Error_Init on an already allocated HPDF_Error_Rec instance.
Dictionary object type from libharu object model. It is referenced as a parameter and return type but is not defined in this header. No additional details available here.
Memory manager handle used by libharu for allocations. It is referenced in constructor but not defined in this header.
Cross-reference table handle used by libharu to manage PDF object xref entries. Referenced but not defined here.
External graphics state object handle used in PDF to store parameters like line styles, transparency, etc. Only referenced via validation function; not defined in this header.
Boolean type used by libharu APIs. Only referenced as a return type here; not defined in this header.
Enumeration of font types supported by Haru PDF. Used within font attributes to identify the concrete font technology (Type1, TrueType, Type3, CID variants, etc.).

objects.definition: typedef HPDF_Dict HPDF_Font;
objects.description: Alias type for a font object represented as an HPDF_Dict. Acts as the public handle for fonts in the library. The concrete structure is not defined here; it is a typedef to HPDF_Dict from elsewhere.
Function pointer type returning HPDF_TextWidth for a run of text in a given font. Implementations compute aggregate character widths for the specified text buffer and length.

objects.definition:
typedef HPDF_UINT
(*HPDF_Font_MeasureText_Func)  (HPDF_Font        font,
                              const HPDF_BYTE  *text,

objects.description: Function pointer type for measuring how much of a text buffer fits into a given width with specified typographic parameters. Returns number of bytes that fit; optionally outputs the measured width.

Opaque handle (HPDF_FontAttr) to the internal font attribute record (HPDF_FontAttr_Rec). The record stores font metadata, function pointers to width/measure routines, encoder, cached glyph widths/usage for single-byte encodings, and references to related PDF objects (xref, descendant font, mapping streams). Construction and lifecycle are managed internally by font creation routines; clients should not allocate or free directly.
Glyph metadata entry mapping character code and Unicode to advance width for Type1 fonts. Used in width tables.
Enumeration of font definition kinds handled by the library.
CID-to-width mapping entry for CID-keyed fonts.

Opaque handle to a font definition with common metrics, descriptor linkage, and type-specific attribute payload in attr. Lifecycle is managed by the library; do not free fields directly. The clean/free/init callbacks are set per subtype.

objects.definition: typedef void  (*HPDF_FontDef_FreeFunc)  (HPDF_FontDef  fontdef);
objects.description: Callback type used inside HPDF_FontDef_Rec to free subtype-specific resources.

objects.definition: typedef void  (*HPDF_FontDef_CleanFunc)  (HPDF_FontDef  fontdef);
objects.description: Callback type for cleaning up a fontdef without full free, used internally by HPDF_FontDef.

objects.definition: typedef HPDF_STATUS  (*HPDF_FontDef_InitFunc)  (HPDF_FontDef  fontdef);
objects.description: Initialization callback type for subtype-specific HPDF_FontDef setup.
Type1-specific attribute block stored in HPDF_FontDef.attr for Type1 fonts, including widths array, encoding info, and PFB segment lengths.
Single TrueType table directory entry (tag, checksum, offset, length).
Parsed TrueType/OTF Offset Table and pointer to its table records.
Representation of a format 4 CMAP subtable ranges, including segment arrays and glyph id array.
Glyph location info: base offset to glyf/loca and per-glyph offsets with usage flags.
Horizontal metrics pair as in hmtx table: advance width and left side bearing.
HEAD table fields for a TrueType/OTF font.
Single record from the NAME table describing a string entry.
Parsed NAME table header and pointer to its records.
TrueType-specific attribute block stored in HPDF_FontDef.attr, holding parsed TTF/OTF tables, metrics, naming, and embedding flags.
CID-keyed font attribute block stored in HPDF_FontDef.attr, including default width (DW), vertical metrics (DW2), and a list of CID width entries.

Graphic state record for libHaru, representing the current drawing/text state (CTM, stroke/fill parameters, text parameters, color spaces/colors, font, writing mode). It forms a linked stack via the 'prev' pointer and tracks nesting with 'depth'. Many field types are defined in other headers. Construction and destruction are via HPDF_GState_New/HPDF_GState_Free.
Opaque handle/reference to a PDF image object used by libHaru APIs. This header only declares functions that consume or return HPDF_Image; the actual type definition is not present here.
Opaque handle for the libHaru memory manager. Only referenced here as a parameter; not defined in this header.
Typedef alias for an 8-bit byte type used by libHaru. Only referenced here; not defined in this header. Pointer form indicates buffers passed to image loaders.
Opaque handle to the cross-reference table used in a PDF document. Referenced as a parameter; not defined here.
Typedef alias for an unsigned integer type used by libHaru. Only referenced here; not defined in this header.
Typedef alias representing a boolean value in libHaru. Only referenced here; not defined in this header.
Opaque stream handle for input data sources (PNG/JPEG/RAW). Only referenced here; not defined in this header.
Enumeration or handle indicating a color space (e.g., DeviceRGB, Gray). Only referenced here; not defined in this header.
Handle to a PDF array object used for setting image ColorSpace directly. Only referenced here; not defined in this header.
Status/error code type returned by many Haru PDF API functions. Not defined in this header; likely an enum or integer typedef in included headers. Details unknown in this file.
Dictionary object handle used within Haru PDF to represent PDF dictionaries such as the document Info dictionary. Not defined in this header; details unknown here.
Enum-like type indicating which Info attribute (Title, Author, etc.) is being set or retrieved. Not defined in this header; details unknown here.
Encoder handle specifying character encoding for string values stored in the Info dictionary. Not defined in this header; details unknown here.
Date/time structure used for Info dictionary date attributes (e.g., CreationDate, ModDate). Not defined in this header; details unknown here.

Opaque handle to a growable list container used inside libharu. Internally implemented by HPDF_List_Rec, it stores void* items in blocks, tracking allocator (mmgr), error handler, block size, items per block, and item count. Items are not owned or freed by the list unless documented elsewhere; this header does not specify ownership semantics.

Concrete structure backing HPDF_List. Holds allocator and error context along with metadata and storage pointer array for list items. Intended for internal use; external users should prefer HPDF_List opaque handle.

Opaque/public pointer type to a memory-pool node used by the Haru memory manager. Each node holds a buffer, its total size, the used size, and a link to the next node (forming a singly-linked list for the pool). Intended for internal use by the memory manager.

Opaque/public pointer type to the Haru memory manager. Holds error handling, custom allocation/free callbacks, an optional memory-pool head node, and configuration such as buffer size. In debug builds it also tracks allocation/free counters.
Concrete struct definition for a memory-pool node. Contains the backing buffer pointer, total capacity, current used size, and link to the next node in the pool.
Concrete struct definition for the Haru memory manager. Stores error object, allocation/free function pointers, memory pool head node, pool buffer size, and optional debug counters.

Opaque handle to a PDF Names dictionary. Only forward-declared/used here; its concrete definition is not present in this header. It represents the document’s /Names dictionary node used to store name trees for various categories (e.g., Dests, EmbeddedFiles).

Opaque handle to a PDF NameTree object. The actual struct/class definition is not provided in this header. It represents a mapping from names (strings) to PDF objects and is used under the Names dictionary for categories like Dests or EmbeddedFiles.
Opaque handle to an EmbeddedFile object representing a file stream embedded into the PDF. The concrete type is not defined in this header; only its API is exposed here.
Enumeration-like key type used to select a specific name tree within a Names dictionary (e.g., Dests, EmbeddedFiles). Not defined in this header; only referenced as a parameter type.
Opaque memory manager handle used throughout libharu for object allocation. Not defined here; only referenced.
Opaque cross-reference table handle representing the PDF file’s xref context, used during object creation. Not defined here; only referenced.
Handle to a PDF String object. Not defined here; only referenced.
Status code type returned by many libharu functions. Only referenced here; definition not present in this header.
Boolean type used by libharu APIs. Only referenced here; definition not present in this header.
Common object header embedded as first field of most Haru PDF objects. Carries object id, generation number, and class/type flags used for ownership/serialization semantics.
Represents a PDF null object. Contains only the common header.
Boolean PDF object with a HPDF_BOOL value.
Integer number PDF object (32-bit signed).
Real (floating-point) PDF object with an associated error handle and value.
PDF name object holding a name string limited by HPDF_LIMIT_MAX_NAME_LEN.
PDF string object with memory manager, encoder, byte buffer and length. Supports encryption-aware write and comparison.
Binary data object for arbitrary byte arrays stored in a PDF context.
PDF array object backed by an internal list. Can hold heterogeneous PDF objects.
Cross-reference table structure maintaining object entries, offsets, and trailer dictionary for a PDF file. May be chained via prev for incremental updates.
Generic PDF dictionary object with key/value list and optional stream/filtering support. Serves as the base for many specialized PDF constructs via typedef aliases listed in aliases.
Internal key/value pair node used inside HPDF_Dict's list. Stores a name key and a value pointer to a PDF object.
Proxy wrapper pointing to another object, allowing indirection within collections or xref handling.
Entry in the cross-reference table, describing object usage type, byte offset, generation number, and back-pointer to the object.
Generic direct object holding an opaque byte sequence intended to be embedded as-is in the PDF output stream.

Opaque handle type representing a PDF outline (bookmark) node. This header only declares functions operating on HPDF_Outline; the actual struct/typedef definition is not present here, implying it is defined elsewhere (likely in hpdf_objects.h). The type models a hierarchical outline tree where each node can have parent/child/sibling relations and an opened/closed state.

Opaque handle to the cross-reference table manager for a PDF document. Used during outline construction. Not defined in this header.

The typedef HPDF_PageAttr is a pointer to HPDF_PageAttr_Rec, which contains references to resources (fonts, xobjects, external graphics states, shadings), graphics state, current/text positions and matrix, page contents stream, cross-reference table, compression mode, and PDF version. Construction is managed by the page subsystem; users typically manipulate pages via HPDF_Page APIs, not this struct directly. Details about lifetime and ownership are mostly internal to libHaru; many fields are pointers to other libHaru objects and are not owned by external callers.

Enumeration or typedef representing page numbering styles (e.g., roman, decimal) in libHaru. Referenced as a parameter but not defined in this header. No definition present in this file.
Integer typedef used by libHaru. Referenced as a parameter but not defined in this header. No definition present in this file.
Enumeration of stream backend types used by libharu (unknown, callback-based, file-backed, memory-backed). Controls how HPDF_Stream dispatches I/O operations.
Enumeration for seek origin used with HPDF_Stream_Seek (begin, current, end).

Unsigned integer type used for sizes/lengths. Referenced as a parameter type; not defined here.
Floating-point real number type used for coordinates and parameters. Referenced widely in camera and color setters; not defined here.
Boolean type used in libharu APIs. Referenced for visibility and flags; not defined here.
3D transformation matrix type used to position cameras/nodes in 3D views. Referenced here; actual struct/typedef is not defined in this header.
3D point type used for cross-section center specification. Referenced here; not defined in this header.
Status/error code type used by libharu APIs. It is referenced here in function declarations but not defined in this header. Definition must exist in included headers.
Handle type representing a PDF document in libharu. Only referenced in this header; not defined here.
Dictionary object handle used by libharu. Only referenced in this header; not defined here.
Type representing PDF/A conformance level selection for PDFA features. Only referenced here; actual definition (likely an enum) is not provided in this header.

Opaque type representing a 3D measurement object in Haru PDF. It is referenced and constructed by factory functions in this header but not defined here; the full definition likely resides in another header or source file.

functions.name: HPDF_GetVersion
functions.description: Returns the library version string.
requirements: No arguments.
Returned pointer refers to static, null-terminated string; do not free.

functions.name: HPDF_NewEx
functions.signature: HPDF_Doc HPDF_NewEx(HPDF_Error_Handler user_error_fn, HPDF_Alloc_Func user_alloc_fn, HPDF_Free_Func user_free_fn, HPDF_UINT mem_pool_buf_size, void *user_data);
functions.description: Creates a new PDF document handle with optional custom error handler and memory management callbacks.
requirements: user_error_fn may be NULL for default handling.
user_alloc_fn/user_free_fn must be provided as a pair if custom allocation is used; otherwise pass NULLs for defaults.
mem_pool_buf_size specifies internal memory pool size; must be a valid unsigned integer.
user_data is passed to callbacks and may be NULL.
Caller must later release with HPDF_Free().

functions.name: HPDF_New
functions.description: Creates a new PDF document handle using default memory management and an optional error handler.
requirements: user_error_fn may be NULL.
user_data is opaque pointer passed to the error handler.
Caller must release with HPDF_Free().

functions.name: HPDF_SetErrorHandler
functions.description: Sets or replaces the error callback for an existing document.
requirements: pdf must be a valid document created by HPDF_New/HPDF_NewEx and not freed.
user_error_fn may be NULL to clear and use default handling.
Check returned HPDF_STATUS for success/failure.

functions.name: HPDF_Free
functions.description: Frees a PDF document and all associated resources.
requirements: pdf must be a document created by HPDF_New/HPDF_NewEx; passing NULL is allowed but has no effect (behavior not explicitly documented).
After this call, pdf becomes invalid and must not be used.

functions.name: HPDF_GetDocMMgr
functions.description: Returns the memory manager associated with a document.
requirements: doc must be a valid document handle and not freed.
Returned handle is owned by the document; do not free directly.

functions.name: HPDF_NewDoc
functions.description: Initializes a new document within an existing HPDF_Doc handle (e.g., after freeing pages/objects).
requirements: pdf must be valid and not already have an open document state conflicting with creation.
Check return HPDF_STATUS.

functions.name: HPDF_FreeDoc
functions.description: Closes the current document associated with the handle without destroying the handle itself.
requirements: pdf must be a valid document handle.
After call, you may reuse the handle with HPDF_NewDoc; do not use previously created pages/objects.

functions.name: HPDF_HasDoc
functions.description: Returns non-zero if the document handle currently has an active document.
requirements: pdf must be a valid document handle.
Return is a boolean-like value.

functions.name: HPDF_FreeDocAll
functions.description: Frees the current document and all related internal resources associated with the handle (stronger than HPDF_FreeDoc).
requirements: pdf must be valid.
After call, previously created objects are invalid; handle may be reusable depending on library design.

functions.name: HPDF_SaveToStream
functions.description: Finalizes the current document and writes it to the internal memory stream for later retrieval.
requirements: pdf must be valid and contain a properly constructed document.
Call HPDF_GetStreamSize/HPDF_ReadFromStream to retrieve data.
Check return status.

functions.name: HPDF_GetContents
functions.description: Reads document bytes from the internal stream into a caller buffer; size in/out parameter controls amount read.
requirements: pdf must be valid and previously saved to stream (HPDF_SaveToStream).
buf must point to a buffer of at least *size bytes; size must be non-NULL.
On input, *size is buffer capacity; on output, set to bytes written.
Check status for partial/complete read semantics.

functions.name: HPDF_GetStreamSize
functions.description: Returns the total size in bytes of the internal memory stream for the current document.
requirements: pdf must be valid and saved to stream.
Use before allocating buffer for HPDF_ReadFromStream/HPDF_GetContents.

functions.name: HPDF_ReadFromStream
functions.description: Reads bytes from the current position of the internal stream into buf; advances the stream position.
requirements: pdf must be valid and saved to stream.
buf must be a valid buffer; size must be non-NULL and indicate capacity on input; set to bytes read on output.
Use HPDF_ResetStream to rewind.

functions.name: HPDF_ResetStream
functions.description: Resets the internal stream read position to the beginning.
requirements: pdf must be valid with a saved stream.
Check status.

functions.name: HPDF_SaveToFile
functions.description: Writes the finished PDF document directly to a file.
requirements: pdf must be valid and the document finalized or finalizable.
file_name must be a valid, writable path to a file; null-terminated.
Check returned status for I/O errors.

functions.name: HPDF_GetError
functions.description: Returns the last error code for the document.
requirements: pdf must be valid.
Interpret non-zero as error per library docs.

functions.name: HPDF_GetErrorDetail
functions.description: Returns additional error detail code for the last error.
requirements: pdf must be valid.
Use after HPDF_GetError to refine diagnostics.

functions.name: HPDF_ResetError
functions.description: Clears the current error state for the document.
requirements: pdf must be valid.
Call after handling an error to continue operations.

functions.name: HPDF_CheckError
functions.description: Checks an error object and returns its status code.
requirements: error must be a valid HPDF_Error handle (typically from internal structures).
Used mainly with low-level APIs.

functions.name: HPDF_SetPagesConfiguration

functions.name: HPDF_GetPageByIndex

requirements: pdf must be valid and contain at least index+1 pages.

functions.name: HPDF_SetPDFAConformance
functions.description: Sets PDF/A conformance level for the document.
requirements: pdf must be valid and no conflicting features already used.
pdfa_type must be a valid HPDF_PDFAType constant.

functions.name: HPDF_GetPageMMgr

functions.name: HPDF_SetOpenAction
